OUR CLINICAL METHODOLOGY

The 4-Pillar Non-Surgical Recovery Journey.

Unlike standard clinics offering generic oil massages, Dr. Surabhi Vaidya uses a structured, scientific 4-phase protocol combining ancient Marma Chikitsa with evidence-backed Ayurvedic Panchakarma.

01

Naadi Pariksha & Postural Biomechanical Analysis

We begin by diagnosing the root cause through ancient Ayurvedic pulse diagnosis (Naadi Pariksha) combined with modern postural, muscle strength, and pelvic alignment testing.

  • Pinpoints Vata dosha accumulation and nerve entrapment (L4-L5, Sciatic nerve)
  • Identifies asymmetry in gait, leg length discrepancy, and joint space reduction
  • Eliminates guesswork before prescribing any therapy
02

Instant Pressure Decompression via Marma Chikitsa

Marma points are vital anatomical energy centers where nerves, blood vessels, and ligaments intersect. Stimulating precise points immediately releases deep muscular spasm.

  • Instant decompression on pinched nerves and compressed knee cartilage
  • Restores proper neuro-muscular electrical conductivity
  • Delivers 20% to 30% visible pain relief right in the first session
03

Deep Joint Lubrication: Pottali Sekam & Medicated Steam

Using hot medicated herbal boluses (Pottali Sekam) and full-body herbal decoction steam, we eliminate joint inflammation, flush deep toxins (Ama), and nourish synovial fluid.

  • Targeted herbal Lepam paste applied to soothe heated inflammation
  • Stimulates natural regeneration of articular joint lubrication
  • Relieves chronic stiffness, swelling, and burning sensations
04

Functional Rehabilitation & Anti-Inflammatory Diet

Pain relief is only sustained when your daily posture and nutrition support joint health. We provide customized home routines so your pain does not return.

  • Gentle joint-strengthening micro-movements and yogic therapy
  • Personalized dietary guidelines to stop inflammatory food triggers
  • Home posture ergonomics for bed, chair, and travel comfort

"Living in pain is not inevitable at your age. Surgery is not your only choice."
